title: First-run model setup screen and start-destination routing
description: On launch, if the models needed for the selected language are missing, show a setup screen that downloads them with a progress bar and a retry button; otherwise go to the home screen. Serves goal 1.
steps: Create `ui/setup/ModelSetupViewModel.kt`: constructor `(downloader: ModelDownloader, store: ModelStore, bundles: List<ModelBundle>)`. State `data class SetupUiState(val totalBytes: Long, val doneBytes: Long = 0, val running: Boolean = false, val error: String? = null, val finished: Boolean = false)` exposed as `StateFlow`. `fun start()` launches in `viewModelScope` collecting `downloader.download(store.missing(bundles))`, updating state; on `ModelDownloadException` set `error = e.message`, `running = false`. `start()` does nothing if already running. `finished = true` on Completed.

Create `ui/setup/ModelSetupScreen.kt`: title "Download speech models", text "About N MB will be downloaded once and stored on this device." (N = totalBytes / 1_000_000), a `LinearProgressIndicator(progress = { done/total })` and `"x MB / y MB"` while running, a button "Download" (idle) or "Retry" (error, with the error text in `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error`). When `finished` becomes true call `onFinished()`.

In `AppNavHost`, add route `setup`. Make `AppNavHost` take a `startDestination: String` parameter. In `MainActivity.onCreate` compute it: `if (container.modelStore.missing(ModelCatalog.requiredFor("en")).isEmpty()) "home" else "setup"` (the language becomes a setting in a later task; use "en" now). On finish navigate to `home` with `popUpTo("setup") { inclusive = true }`.
Create the ViewModel with `viewModel(factory = viewModelFactory { initializer { ModelSetupViewModel(...) } })` reading from `(LocalContext.current.applicationContext as ConvoApp).container`.

Write `ui/setup/ModelSetupViewModelTest.kt` with a fake: make `ModelDownloader` usage testable by introducing `interface ModelDownloads { fun download(bundles: List<ModelBundle>): Flow<DownloadEvent> }` implemented by `ModelDownloader`, and have the ViewModel depend on the interface. Use `Dispatchers.setMain(StandardTestDispatcher())` in @Before and `resetMain()` in @After.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: after `start()` with a fake emitting Progress(50,100) then Completed, an intermediate state has doneBytes == 50 (collect states with Turbine) and the final state has `finished == true` and `running == false`
Test: fake throwing ModelDownloadException("HTTP 500 for x") gives `error == "HTTP 500 for x"` and `running == false`; calling `start()` again clears the error and runs again
Test: calling `start()` twice while running collects the downloader only once
`MainActivity` chooses `setup` when models are missing (code path visible in `MainActivity.kt`)
